## taskloom status

Change the status of a task

### Synopsis

Change the status of a task.

Use "Deferred" with --trigger to park a task on a named revive condition; the
task then hides from the default list until the trigger fires. A task already
carrying a trigger keeps it when re-deferred, so --trigger is optional then.

```
taskloom status <harp-id> <status> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help             help for status
      --trigger string   revive condition when setting status to Deferred
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --project string   Project id to act on (overrides the session's CTXLOOM_PROJECT_ID pin and cwd resolution)
```
